template.title: Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note
template.governing_standard: Joint MDB Paris Alignment Methodology (BB1 Mitigation / BB2 Adaptation) & Environmental/Social Framework

fields.label: Project Title & Legal Sponsor
fields.description: Official project name, sponsor legal entity, and host jurisdiction.

fields.label: Financing Window (Sovereign vs. Non-Sovereign / Private Sector)
fields.description: Maps applicant legal type to the MDB's Sovereign, Sub-Sovereign, or Non-Sovereign Operations (NSO) window.

fields.label: COP31 Country Platform & Flagship Initiative Alignment
fields.description: Alignment with the MDB's COP31 Antalya 2026 initiatives (e.g., TIDIP, Electrify Now, Climate Adaptation Plan Phase 2, GET 2026-30).

fields.label: Requested Financing Instrument & Amount (USD)
fields.description: Recommended MDB financial instrument matched against ticket size limits and applicant preferences.

fields.label: Total Project Cost & Co-Financing Mobilization Plan
fields.description: Breakdown of total project capex, sponsor equity, committed co-financing, and private capital mobilization ratio.

fields.label: Paris Agreement Alignment Assessment (BB1 Mitigation & BB2 Physical Risk)
fields.description: Verifies alignment with host-country NDC, low-carbon transition pathways (BB1), and climate resilience (BB2).

fields.label: Quantified Climate Impact (tCO2e/year Avoided &/or Adaptation Beneficiaries)
fields.description: Expected annual GHG reductions and/or direct climate adaptation beneficiaries.

fields.label: Environmental & Social (E&S) Safeguards & EIA Status
fields.description: E&S risk screening, EIA permit status, and compliance with MDB Environmental & Social Standards.

fields.label: Financial Viability & Bankability Indicators (Revenue, EBITDA, IRR)
fields.description: Key financial metrics demonstrating project creditworthiness and debt-service capacity.

fields.label: Project Readiness Stage & Implementation Schedule
fields.description: Current project development maturity and expected construction/deployment duration.

fields.label: Key Technical, Market & Climate Risks with Mitigants
fields.description: Primary execution risks and risk-sharing / credit enhancement mitigants.

fields.label: Executive Concept Note Abstract
fields.description: Concise decision-ready summary tailored to the MDB investment committee.
